name: Portsea London Bridge Clifftop Walk
signature: A dramatic clifftop walk from Portsea Back Beach to London Bridge — limestone arches, Bass Strait below, and the most spectacular short walk on the tip
editorNote:
The walk from Portsea Back Beach to London Bridge follows the clifftop east — a 3km return walk above dramatic limestone cliffs with Bass Strait below and the hinterland behind. London Bridge itself is a natural limestone arch that extends over the water — one of those formations that looks improbable from every angle.

The clifftop path is largely informal but well-worn. The views back toward Portsea and forward toward Sorrento are among the best on the Peninsula. The walk is exposed — wind and sun in equal measure — so dress accordingly.

Combine with a swim at Portsea Back Beach and lunch at the Portsea Hotel for a complete Portsea day. Allow about 90 minutes return including time to explore the London Bridge platform.
whyWeGo: The best clifftop walk on the tip — London Bridge, Bass Strait below, and views most visitors never find.
ifOnlyOneThing: Walk to London Bridge and look back toward Portsea from the arch. It reframes the whole tip of the Peninsula.
